tia: FYI onboarding sample app produced duplicate list items when we hit a burst + token rotate. Repro below.
omar: Which SDK?
tia: JS sampleapp. We used throttle windowMs=1200,maxRequests=40 and pageSize=30. On token refresh some pages were applied twice.
devon: Sounds like auth-refresh replay + aggressive batching. Short-term: add client-side page id header and drop duplicates on client.
tia: I tried `x-redwood-page-id: ${session}:${seq}` and duplicates disappeared.
omar: Can we make an SDK change so apps don't have to patch sampleapp?
devon: Yes - add a small paginator dedupe hook + automatic page-id injection. Also tighten JS default throttle to something like 500ms/10req. I'll open an issue.
ci-bot: devon opened issue devex/1801: "paginator page-id + SDK dedupe hook"
tia: I'll add a short note to the onboarding README with the workaround and repro steps.
